parts.text: A student uses an electric motor to turn a wheel, as shown in Figure 4.1.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The current in the motor is 1.2 A. The potential difference (p.d.) across the motor is 24 V. Calculate the energy transferred to the motor in a time of 30 s. energy transferred = ....................................................... J [3]

ms.label: 4(a)(ii)
ms.text:
(energy transferred =) 860 (J)
(energy transferred =) 1.2 × 30 × 24
(energy transferred =) I × t × V

ms.text:

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Some power stations burn fossil fuels to generate electrical power.

ms.label: 4(b)(i)
ms.text:

ms.text:
